name: DepApp Dictionary Main
brief: Companion of depapp-dictionary-dep: pins AL Dictionary behaviour when the codeunit lives in a SOURCE-COMPILED dependency.
description: Written to reproduce the Pageworks cluster of 8 failures — ArgumentNullException (Parameter 'parent') out of SharedNavObjectDictionary..ctor, reached from a dep-app codeunit — and it does NOT reproduce it: all four cases passed before the NavObjectDictionary Cecil rewrite landed. So 'the dictionary lives in a dependency' is not by itself the trigger; a source-compiled dependency like this one works fine, while Pageworks' failing dependency is a PRECOMPILED .app. The distinguishing factor was never isolated, and this suite is deliberately not claimed as coverage of that cluster. It is kept as a regression pin for the dependency path that does work, across three distinct closed instantiations plus a negative case, so that a future change to the get_Target rewrite or to dep-app session wiring fails loudly here. The value-type instantiation is the one worth keeping deliberately: reference-type instantiations can be covered incidentally through CLR __Canon body sharing, value-type ones cannot.
